rows.text: This is your first day at the Interastral Peace Corporation. Staring at the towering IPC branch building, you are determined to become an excellent IPC employee.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You straighten up confidently! The level P-13 staff badge on your chest gleams brightly under the sun. But no... P-13 is not going to define you! Your *ambition* reaches far beyond it...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Dedicate off-duty time to the Amber Lord.
Accurately find the target to sell star systems to.
